description: 2D collapse of a water column a x 2a (n^2 = 2, a = 2.25 in = 0.05715 m) in a closed tank, two-phase CFD with level set (set-up of tutorial 11_1 scaled to the experiment). Surge-front arrival at gauges Z = x/a = 1.5..10 as T = t sqrt(2g/a) against Martin & Moyce (1952). The front has arrived when the surface is 0.05 a above the bed.

reference.citation: Martin, J.C. & Moyce, W.J. (1952) An experimental study of the collapse of liquid columns on a rigid horizontal plane. Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A 244, 312-324; n^2 = 2, a = 2.25 in, surge front Z(T) digitised from Fig. 3 (secondary: PySPH db_exp_data.py), see refdata/dambreak/PROVENANCE.md

check.note: the largest deviation is at Z = 1.5 (front 20 % early): the experiment includes the opening of the column, the simulation starts from rest without it
